rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: An SPA report datelined Riyadh 29 Safar 1446 / 2 September 2024 prints Royal Order A/84 dated 29/02/1446 AH, issued that day by King Salman: the Shura Council consists of 'معالي الشيخ الدكتور عبدالله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ - رئيساً -' and 150 named members for four Hijri years from 3/3/1446 AH; it recites A/146 of 1/3/1442.
rows.locator: Dateline; order number and date; recitals; items First and Second; trailer 16:14 Makkah time

rows.text: Under A/84 the term starts on 3/3/1446 AH; SPA datelines print that day as 6 September 2024.
